# Supabase JavaScript SDK

Pinned version: `@supabase/supabase-js@2.118.0`, unchanged from the prior CDN dependency.

Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2.118.0/dist/umd/supabase.js

SHA-256: `ee3be8de192b97cb1d73d1e95d6b82bb1f6b658c0f97c4ef757fc331996ed3d3`

License: MIT; retained in `supabase-LICENSE`.

The versioned script is served on the app origin and precached with the app shell. Only this immutable SDK uses cache-first delivery; application files retain network-first updates. Change the filename, loader, and service worker together when updating it. No auth tokens are cached by the service worker.
